note: Scope inventory only; all capabilities require current behavioral evidence. No cap on child task count. Six inherited aggregate domains do not prove all Fabushi functions covered; their source owners must be expanded.

stage_definitions.file_mapped: Upstream C++ or inherited Fabushi files are mapped in existing on-disk ledger shards with pinned revision/SHA256. Does not prove reachability or runtime behavior.
stage_definitions.entrypoint_reachable: Target Rust/GPUI symbols are wired into live AppShell or Axum router call graphs without dead-code suppression, static placeholder banners, or bare pub use * shims.
stage_definitions.behavior_tested: Positive and negative behavioral tests against real durable state/storage pass with recorded candidate provenance.
stage_definitions.ui_evidence_captured: Actual running GPUI binary renders and interactive state transitions are captured and verified against upstream Telegram reference behavior.
stage_definitions.packaged_accepted: Packaged application passes end-to-end service flows, restart/reconnect durability, signing/update/rollback, and retained Fabushi regression checks.
